$comment: Per-claim state semantics (merged design). NOT a single blended quality score.

claim_statuses.SATISFIED: claim met by admissible current-head evidence
claim_statuses.UNSUPPORTED: claim family not supported by supplied evidence
claim_statuses.STALE: evidence bound to a superseded head SHA
claim_statuses.NOT_APPLICABLE: claim does not apply to this change

non_compensatory: A required claim that is missing/stale/failed/conflicting/unsupported/inadmissible cannot be compensated by optional claims or by any aggregate coverage score.
